name: Guardrail: Concurrent identical PO submissions must be deduplicated (prevent duplicate AP liability)
statusMessage:
Error: [IDENTICAL_PO_RACE_CONDITION] Concurrent identical PO submissions were both created without deduplication.
  POs Created: 2 (PO/2026/09/03/002320 + PO/2026/09/03/002321)
  AP Liability Inflated: $2000.00 (Expected: $1000.00)
  Impact: Artificial double-entry liability inflation on Accounts Payable GL.
  Fix Required: Backend must enforce atomic transaction lock or idempotency hash check on vendor+item+amount payload.
